name: consult
description: Ask Codex, Antigravity (agy) and local models for a second opinion, chat with them, run a ranked council, or generate images with agy or GPT through Codex.
long_description:
Wraps the Codex and Antigravity (agy) CLIs, the legacy Gemini CLI, and any local OpenAI-compatible runner (llama-swap, Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server, vLLM) as tools: one-shot asks with optional images, multi-turn chat, a council that ranks parallel answers by Borda count, and image generation through Antigravity (Google) or through Codex (GPT images under your ChatGPT plan).

**Requires** the CLIs you want to use to be installed and signed in on this machine (`codex login`; run `agy` once). Nothing is bundled except the MCP server itself.

Settings are read from `.claude/consult.local.md` in the server's working directory, falling back to `~/.claude/consult.local.md`. Under Claude Desktop that is effectively always the global file.

The same server ships in the `consult` Claude Code plugin, which adds slash commands and an auto-triggering skill on top.

tools.name: ask_codex
tools.description: Ask the Codex CLI (OpenAI) a question, optionally with images.

tools.name: ask_agy
tools.description: Ask the Antigravity CLI (Google; also fronts Claude and GPT-OSS models).

tools.name: agy_generate_image
tools.description: Generate images with Antigravity and save them to disk.

tools.name: codex_generate_image
tools.description: Generate GPT images through the Codex CLI and save them to disk.

tools.name: agy_status
tools.description: Check agy sign-in, list reachable models, report its file-write posture.

tools.name: ask_gemini
tools.description: Ask the legacy Gemini CLI (needs a paid API key).

tools.name: ask_local
tools.description: Ask a local model (llama-swap, Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server, any OpenAI-compatible runner).

tools.name: local_status
tools.description: Check the local runner and list its models.

tools.name: local_setup
tools.description: Set up local runners and model nicknames; saves only what you confirm.

tools.name: local_unload
tools.description: Unload the models a local runner holds, after you agree.

tools.name: codex_login_status
tools.description: Check whether the Codex CLI is signed in.

tools.name: codex_login_start
tools.description: Start a Codex device sign-in and return the URL.

tools.name: gemini_auth_status
tools.description: Diagnose the legacy Gemini CLI's auth.

tools.name: consult_chat_start
tools.description: Start a multi-turn chat with codex, agy or gemini.

tools.name: consult_chat_send
tools.description: Send the next message in a chat.

tools.name: consult_chat_end
tools.description: End a chat and delete its session from disk.

tools.name: council_vote
tools.description: Send one prompt to several models, have them rank each other, return the winner.
